newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares seen climbing on Dow and dollar.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares seen climbing on Dow and dollar.

text.p: Danish share prices rose in early trade on Wednesday, buoyed by the strong dollar and Tuesday's Dow Jones rise, with dealers seeing more gains ahead.
"Although there was a dearth of buyers yesterday, we should push on upwards today with more rises given the strength of the dollar and the Dow rise last night," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.12 point to 166.14 at 0740 gmt, having closed 1.08 point down on Tuesday.
